design_notes: F01 to F40 of design section 12.4. Fact IDs are not flight phases: a flight-phase ID (F0 to F14) appears in this file only inside used_in.flight_phases.

text_key is the on-screen sentence, 25 words or fewer (12.1). The bank column "Fact (draft)" is a keyword line, so the sentence is the one the design uses where it tells the fact (the Fact line of the minigame in 10.5, the "Did you know?" or table text of section 7, the failure model of 8.4, the abort table of 9.8), cut to 25 words where it was longer; detail_key then holds the full design sentence for the Codex. Every number is the one the design prints.

topic_key, used_in and source_key are the Topic, Used in and Source to cite columns. "§7.x" is stored as the part category of that section, "§6.10" as the rocket preview channel, "§9.8" as the abort-modes channel.
